dict.Pasul obligatoriu înainte de ordonanța d: The mandatory step before a court payment order: the unpaid invoices (certain, liquid and due amounts), the contract they come from, the penalties or statutory interest, the 40 euros per invoice for recovery costs, the 15-day deadline and how to send it (bailiff or registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt)
dict.Facturile plătite târziu sau încă neplăt: Invoices paid late or still unpaid, with their due date: from the days of delay come the contract penalties (the daily rate, at most the amount owed) or, without such a clause, the statutory interest (the central bank rate plus 8 points between companies), the 40 € per invoice for recovery costs and the total to claim in the payment demand.
dict.Penalitatea din contract, pe zi (0 = făr: Contract penalty per day (0 = no clause)
dict.Penalitățile nu trec de suma datorată: Penalties do not exceed the amount owed
dict.Dobânda de referință BNR, pe an: Central bank reference rate, per year
dict.Puncte peste ea (8% între firme, 4% în r: Points above it (8% between companies, 4% otherwise)
dict.Total de cerut în somație: Total to claim in the payment demand
dict.Penalitățile se cer doar dacă sunt scris: Penalties can be claimed only if the contract provides for them; otherwise claim the statutory interest (enter in O4 the reference rate from the central bank website).
dict.Cei 40 € pe factură se cer doar de la fi: The 40 € per invoice can be claimed only from companies or public institutions, for invoices paid after the due date.
dict.Facturile plătite târziu intră cu data p: Invoices paid late are entered with their payment date: only the penalties remain to be claimed. The payment demand: Docs → Templates → Formal payment demand.
